title: eKYC verification timing out
alert: kyc-service vendor timeouts at 35%; customer neha.r@gmail.com stuck at onboarding
root cause: The eKYC vendor lowered our rate limit and requests above it hung until timeout
fix: Added a token-bucket queue at the new vendor limit and retried queued verifications

title: Settlement file upload failed
alert: SFTP authentication failed uploading the settlement file to Axis; merchant payouts delayed
root cause: Axis rotated its SFTP host key and our client rejected the new fingerprint
failed fixes: Retrying the upload repeatedly (locked the SFTP account)
fix: Bank ops unlocked the account, we added the new host fingerprint and re-uploaded the file

title: UPI callbacks delayed from partner bank
alert: upi-switch callback latency p99 8.2s for Kotak, pending transactions growing
root cause: Kotak was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
fix: Enabled the bank-level circuit breaker for Kotak and showed a "bank is slow" banner in the app

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: payments-api p99 6.4s during the Diwali sale, Hikari waiting threads above 150
root cause: maxPoolSize was 20 and idle-in-transaction sessions held connections open during the Diwali sale
failed fixes: Scaling payments-db to a bigger instance
fix: Killed idle-in-transaction sessions and raised maxPoolSize from 20 to 60

title: Customers charged twice
alert: Duplicate debits reported; card 4539 8812 0093 2211, customer phone 9876501234
root cause: Checkout retried after a gateway timeout without an idempotency key, so the charge ran twice
failed fixes: Issuing manual refunds one by one
fix: Added an idempotency key on transaction id and auto-reversed the duplicate charges

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=55%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during the Diwali sale used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: UPI callbacks delayed from partner bank
alert: upi-switch callback latency p99 8.2s for ICICI, pending transactions growing
root cause: ICICI was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
fix: Enabled the bank-level circuit breaker for ICICI and showed a "bank is slow" banner in the app
